sloka: स्वयम् एव हि धर्मात्मा प्रयातो मुनि शासनात् ।सुमंत्रः त्वरितो भूत्वा समानेतुम् महामतिः ॥१-१३-३१॥
transliteration: svayam eva hi dharmātmā prayāto muni śāsanāt ।sumaṁtraḥ tvarito bhūtvā samānetum mahāmatiḥ ॥1-13-31॥

translations.english: Meanwhile kings from several countries to travelling nights and days arrived bringing with them various kinds of (precious) gifts.
